canonicalRoleMeaningCandidate.zh-Hans: 出生时刻的激活层。在现有来源中，它与较可被显意识辨认、较容易进入自我观察与主动解释的结构相连；既有 MIR/HDR successor 也已把多项 PERSONALITY activation 绑定到 Life Theme、Evolution、IQ、EQ、Pearl 等解释角色。
canonicalRoleMeaningCandidate.en: The birth-moment activation layer. Existing sources associate it with patterns more available to conscious recognition, self-observation, and deliberate interpretation; the MIR/HDR successor also binds multiple PERSONALITY activations to roles such as Life Theme, Evolution, IQ, EQ, and Pearl.

records.boundary: More consciously recognizable does not mean every activation is consciously known, mental-only, correct, fixed, or currently active. PERSONALITY remains baseline and is not Current Reality.

canonicalRoleMeaningCandidate.zh-Hans: 受治理的出生前 88° 太阳弧激活层。在现有来源中，它与较不容易被直接意识察觉、更多作为背景或身体化运行被体验到的结构相连；既有 MIR/HDR successor 已把 DESIGN activation 绑定到 Radiance、Purpose、Attraction、SQ、Vocation/Core-Wound、Culture 等解释角色。
canonicalRoleMeaningCandidate.en: The governed pre-birth 88° solar-arc activation layer. Existing sources associate it with patterns less directly available to conscious recognition and more often encountered as background or embodied operation; the MIR/HDR successor binds DESIGN activations to roles such as Radiance, Purpose, Attraction, SQ, Vocation/Core-Wound, and Culture.

records.boundary: Less directly conscious does not mean unknowable, biologically caused, more true, fixed, or currently active. DESIGN remains baseline and is not Current Reality.
